editorial.blurb: Bacchanalia is an intimate Italian gem where house-made lasagna and attentive service create the kind of evening that lingers in memory.
editorial.insiderTip: Make reservations ahead—the lasagna is worth the wait, and staff will happily work around your schedule, even accommodating large groups and special occasions with ease.

topDishes.note: made to order, hot and flavorful—reviewers call it the best they've ever tasted
worth a return visit on its own
